title: Saudi e-invoicing reference data: ZATCA business rules, glossary, integration waves and fines
description:
Structured data behind the CashHub Saudi e-invoicing reference (https://cashhubapp.com/en/e-invoicing-reference), checked 2026-10-26.

  • 240 ZATCA business rules from SDK 238-R3.3.8 and the XML implementation standard, with official text, severity and location; 40 of them link to Arabic and English explanation pages.
  • 37 e-invoicing terms with Arabic and English definitions.
  • Phase 2 integration waves 1 to 25: revenue thresholds, dates and announcement links.
  • The 18 offences in ZATCA's violations classification guide (2nd edition, May 2024) with the fine for each repeat, plus the November 2021 figures for comparison.

Every record carries its source. Rule text is ZATCA's own. Not legal advice and not a ZATCA publication; the publisher, CashHub, sells a point-of-sale system in Saudi Arabia.
